# Go Green Restoration Inc

> Bonded and insured restoration company serving DFW Metro Area. 24/7 emergency water damage, fire damage, mold remediation, sewage cleanup, and construction services. IICRC Certified. Eco-friendly methods.

- **Phone**: (469) 727-3217
- **Website**: https://gogreenrestorationtx.com
- **Office**: 1902 Parker Rd, Wylie, TX 75098
- **Service Area**: 150+ cities across the DFW Metroplex
- **Hours**: 24/7 emergency services, Office Mon-Fri 8am-6pm
- **Google Rating**: 5.0 stars
- **Certifications**: IICRC Certified Technicians, Bonded & Insured

## Services

- [Water Damage Restoration](https://gogreenrestorationtx.com/services/water-damage-restoration/): 24/7 emergency water extraction, structural drying, and complete water damage repair for homes and businesses
- [Fire & Smoke Damage Restoration](https://gogreenrestorationtx.com/services/fire-smoke-damage-restoration/): Emergency board-up, soot and smoke removal, odor elimination, and full reconstruction after fire damage
- [Mold Remediation](https://gogreenrestorationtx.com/services/mold-remediation/): Professional mold inspection, testing, containment, removal, and prevention with clearance testing
- [Sewage Backup & Cleanup](https://gogreenrestorationtx.com/services/sewage-backup-cleanup/): Biohazard-safe sewage extraction, sanitization, disinfection, and structural restoration
- [Construction & Remodeling](https://gogreenrestorationtx.com/services/construction-remodeling/): Post-disaster reconstruction, remodeling, structural repairs, and permit handling

## Commercial

- [HOA Restoration Services](https://gogreenrestorationtx.com/commercial/hoa-restoration-services/): Multi-unit damage response, common area restoration, HOA board communication, and preferred vendor programs
- [Property Management Restoration](https://gogreenrestorationtx.com/commercial/property-management-restoration/): Tenant displacement management, recurring maintenance contracts, and portfolio pricing
